hints.title: Four-Part Perimeter Decomposition
hints.text: The boundary consists of the root, the left boundary, all leaf nodes in left-to-right order, and the right boundary in reverse.

hints.title: Spine Traversal with Leaf Exclusion
hints.text: When collecting left and right boundaries, exclude leaf nodes so that leaves are not duplicated when the leaf-collector runs.

hints.title: Order of Assembly
hints.text: Append root if not leaf. Traverse left boundary downwards preferring left child else right child. Traverse leaves in order. Traverse right boundary downwards preferring right child else left child, and append its elements in reverse.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Traversal visits each boundary node and leaf at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph boundary walks or complete perimeter traversals mishandle missing branch edges.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Decomposing into spine walks and leaf collection yields clean linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Separate boundary into root, left boundary, leaves, and reversed right boundary.
